description: Narrow a record page's embedded relation collection for YOURSELF only, leaving what teammates see untouched — same idea as set_personal_filter but for a field's collection widget rather than a saved view. [Full notes: get_started section "TOOL NOTES set_personal_collection_filter"]

clear.description: Remove your entire personal override for this collection (filter, sort, color, columns).

filter.description: A query_records-style filter, evaluated against the TARGET database. Omit with clear:true.

name: set_personal_collection_filter
title: Set my personal filter on an embedded collection
